body: A barebones library for agents that think in code.
plain_description: **Build AI agents that can carry out multi-step tasks using the models and tools you choose.** Create agents in a few lines of Python and share them through Hugging Face Hub. Supports code-driven and tool-calling agents, with optional sandboxed execution.
technical_description: smolagents is a Python library for building model-agnostic agents. Its CodeAgent writes actions as Python code, while ToolCallingAgent uses structured tool calls. It integrates with Hugging Face inference providers, LiteLLM, OpenAI-compatible services, local Transformers and llama.cpp models, MCP servers, LangChain tools, and Hub tools. Agents can use text, vision, video, and audio inputs. Code execution can run in managed cloud sandboxes or Docker; the built-in LocalPythonExecutor is not a security boundary.
title: smolagents
